data.name: Consent_Text
data.value:
I need to save some information in your browser and I have to take this information from you.

But don't worry; I will use this information for theme (dark/light), form etc. So do not worry, your information will not be used for commercial purposes.

data.name: Hero_Desc
data.value: I can develop and improve .NET based corporate and individual applications, integrations, data processing services, dashboards and management panels. I work focused on performance, security and real business needs. I am aesthetic but I also fill the background, I don't do empty work.

data.name: Hero_Card_Desc
data.value: I can increase performance in corporate projects, solve bottleneck problems, develop and simplify logging and security layers, and develop turnkey projects from start to finish.

data.name: About_Desc
data.value: I also understand the corporate side because I have experience working with corporate companies. I am currently active in my full-time job etc. Process, approval, budget, unfinished jobs, panic situations, deadlines... I've seen it all.

data.name: About_Card_Text_1
data.value: I work mainly on back-end (.NET, MSSQL, service design) but I am also comfortable on the front-end (Razor, Bootstrap, dashboard UI, component structures).

data.name: About_Card_Text_2
data.value: My favorite thing: Taking a complex problem and making it simple, traceable, documentable.

data.name: About_Card_Text_3
data.value: I step in where you say “This works but no one wants to touch it because everything is connected”.
